name: What are common signs that my door jamb needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my door jamb needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs your door jamb needs repair include visible cracks, splits in the wood, soft or rotted areas, difficulty opening or closing the door, or a door that no longer latches properly. Drafts around the door frame or increased noise from outside can also indicate a compromised jamb. Addressing these issues promptly helps prevent further damage to your door or frame, maintaining your home's security and energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for cracks, rot, difficulty operating the door, or poor latching as signs your door jamb needs repair.
